decisions.reason: As a newly launched sensor module with its own product page and strong fit to the firm's sensing platform, it is more likely to be supported than withdrawn.
This is a fresh hardware generation replacing an older model in a core measurement category, which signals commitment rather than exit.
MQTT support expands the platform's software connectivity at low marginal cost, so it is strategically useful to keep.
A CAN interface matches German industrial and automation use cases well, making it a sensible module to retain despite lighter website prominence.
CO2 measurement is a relevant use case for schools, labs and building projects, so the module fits the customer base even if it may stay somewhat niche.
The touch panel is the most optional and accessory-like of the launches, so it carries the highest risk, but it still complements prototyping and control projects.
